title: Pasting a coefficient square of higher-image triangle transitions
statement: For arbitrary schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a commutative coefficient ring Λ, and étale Λ-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], use the canonical inverse images and composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the canonical degree-q higher-image triangle transitions [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let a:YU→YV, b:ZU→ZV, cV:ZV→YV and cU:ZU→YU satisfy cU ≫ a=b ≫ cV. Let hV:YV→X, hU:YU→X, kV:ZV→X and kU:ZU→X make all four triangles commute. Let FV,FU,GV,GU be sheaves on YV,YU,ZV,ZU respectively, and d:a*FV→FU, fV:cV*FV→GV, fU:cU*FU→GU and e:b*GV→GU be coefficient maps. Assume the (cU,a) forward composition comparison followed by cU*(d) and fU equals the (b,cV) forward comparison with named composite cU ≫ a, followed by b*(fV) and e. Then for every integer q the higher-image transition along a followed by d, then along cU followed by fU equals the transition along cV followed by fV, then along b followed by e.

source.place: Tags 0F07 (lemma-go-down-to-field), coefficient identification preceding condition (2), and 09Z1, canonical restriction maps.

proof.text: Apply higher_direct_image_transition_composition to a followed by cU, with coefficients d and fU. Apply it to cV followed by b, with coefficients fV and e, transporting its composite to the named arrow cU ≫ a. The supplied coefficient square makes the two composite coefficient maps equal. Apply the higher-image coefficient functor to this equality and paste the two composition equalities. The implementation treats named-composite transport by equality elimination on an independent morphism variable.

lean.statement: theorem higherDirectImage_coefficient_square {X YV YU ZV ZU : Scheme.{u}} (a : YU ⟶ YV) (b : ZU ⟶ ZV) (cV : ZV ⟶ YV) (cU : ZU ⟶ YU) (hV : YV ⟶ X) (hU : YU ⟶ X) (kV : ZV ⟶ X) (kU : ZU ⟶ X) (wa : a ≫ hV = hU) (wb : b ≫ kV = kU) (wV : cV ≫ hV = kV) (wU : cU ≫ hU = kU) (ws : cU ≫ a = b ≫ cV) (q : ℤ) (FV : Sheaf YV.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (FU : Sheaf YU.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (GV : Sheaf ZV.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (GU : Sheaf ZU.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (d : ((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FV ⟶ FU) (fV : ((cV)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FV ⟶ GV) (fU : ((cU)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FU ⟶ GU) (e : ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj GV ⟶ GU) (wc : (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) cU a).hom.app FV ≫ ((cU)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map d ≫ fU = (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b cV (cU ≫ a) ws).hom.app FV ≫ ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map fV ≫ e) : (higherDirectImageTransition Λ a hV hU wa q FV ≫ higherDirectImageMap Λ hU q d) ≫ (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cU hU kU wU q FU ≫ higherDirectImageMap Λ kU q fU) = (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cV hV kV wV q FV ≫ higherDirectImageMap Λ kV q fV) ≫ (higherDirectImageTransition Λ b kV kU wb q GV ≫ higherDirectImageMap Λ kU q e)
